<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant ion at m/z 180.042, which in positive‑mode ESI most commonly corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈179.035 Da. Searching for a formula composed of C, H, O that matches this exact mass yields C₉H₇O₄ (exact mass 179.0344 Da), which is the closest match within experimental tolerance.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
